money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 2 Feb 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 2 Feb 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted special repo starting within one day, <= 3 days (3.66%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 2 Feb 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 3 Feb 2026 (table headed 02.02.2026; only the 2 Feb 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 2 Feb 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 2 Feb 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 2 Feb 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.10% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (DS0726 3.13%, PS1026 3.06%, OK0127 3.10%).

portfolio_meta._source: GPW Benchmark 'Portfele obligacji' communique for the periodic change of 30 Jan 2026 (holdings and statistics as of 27 Jan 2026; scheduled publication 28 Jan 2026). The PDF now served carries 2 Feb 2026 creation metadata (re-upload); every unit change matches MoF settlements up to 26 Jan 2026 and the 28 Jan auction (settled 30 Jan) is excluded, so the content reflects information available by 28 Jan.
